scope: Freeze terminal engineering provider diagnostics and first-failure creation under existing CAS; accurately report separately permitted fixed Starter tests.
riskAnalysis: Late first-seen numeric fields could be added after failure, and a late failure could contradict success. Fix only terminal diagnostic writes; preserve required independent cleanup evidence, historical absence and all existing inference/publication controls.

threatModel.assets: Immutable provider observations, missing usage semantics, terminal result/failure provenance, financial uncertainty and reliable cleanup evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Only existing scoped broker capability enters existing transaction; capability readouts are informational and cannot dispatch source tests.
threatModel.abuseCases: Late or concurrent diagnostic calls invent missing token counts, append failure after success, overwrite failed cleanup or imply execution from static capability metadata.
threatModel.mitigations: Terminal computed inside CAS; block provider-field additions and new failure once failure/resultHash exists; only first boolean cleanup observation may append. Exact local release lock changes; no old grant reuse.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Zero, missing, null and invalid usage fixtures retain exact numeric presence and fail incomplete responses closed.
negativePaths.stale-state: Terminal flag is recomputed inside each existing CAS callback; historical receipts are never migrated.
negativePaths.concurrency: Concurrent conflicting late provider/cleanup writes preserve first committed evidence; new real Redis case verifies shared CAS.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing full-stage cancellation and cleanup fixtures run; late physical cleanup boolean remains separately appendable.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Existing restricted-worker and unconfirmed physical cleanup tests remain mandatory; no worker execution code changed.
negativePaths.api-outage: Existing provider and diagnostic-store failure fixtures retain uncertainty and independent bounded authority cleanup.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing capability tokens, owner/task/source checks unchanged; forged capability regression remains required.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Reservations and observed usage before terminal remain unchanged; late fake usage cannot alter reservations or accepted results.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Incomplete responses stop downstream stages; late failure cannot contradict an already successful resultHash.

rollback: Revert reviewed source and release-lock changes through feature development only; keep all historical receipts, unknown billing and original failed test evidence. No runtime data rollback or audit rewrite.

defects.rootCause: First-observation merging protected populated keys but did not freeze absent fields once terminal evidence existed.
defects.detectionGap: Prior immutable-diagnostic tests used populated usage, so late additions to absent numeric fields were not exercised.
defects.regression: Four empty incomplete usage variants and completed-result late-failure regression plus concurrent cleanup checks and real Redis integration.
defects.historicalPrevention: Require terminal diagnostic immutability to cover absence as well as values, and contradictory terminal receipt creation.

defects.rootCause: Implementation capability metadata still described all tests as unqualified after separately permitted fixed Starter tests were added.
defects.detectionGap: Fixed-test dispatch tests exercised execution independently from shared directory capability readouts.
defects.regression: Check all three shared capability surfaces and detached mutable readouts; preserve execution/publication false.
defects.historicalPrevention: Update capability reporting alongside bounded execution features without implying readiness or granting permissions.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing broker transaction and shared capability function; no alternate journal, ledger, execution controller or publication pathway.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependencies, credentials, provider services or paid infrastructure introduced.
proactiveReview.threats: Protect terminal absence and result/failure consistency without exposing raw provider content or changing trust boundaries.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Diagnostic persistence failure cannot block independent revocation; late cleanup remains explicit rather than inferred.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual late numeric insertion and late failure-after-success reproduced before fix; malformed and concurrent cases tested.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Engineering Auditor reviewed changes; Auditor adjacent terminal finding reproduced and addressed.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve original diagnostics, support case and accounting; paid authority stays closed and Production/main unchanged.
proactiveReview.readiness: Local focused checks pass; full STRICT and exact committed CI/Redis/CodeQL/browser qualification are required before release claims.
